items.headline: Goodell comfortable with security for NFL's Paris game
items.description: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell said Wednesday he has a high comfort level in the Saints and Steelers safely playing in Paris on Sunday in light of the civil unrest in the city.

items.headline: Saints GM Mickey Loomis asks for patience with 'young developing team'
items.description: Saints general manager Mickey Loomis said he understands the recent criticism from owner Gayle Benson but asked for patience with what he called a "young developing team."

items.headline: NFL to increase security in Paris for Steelers-Saints game
items.description: The NFL said security will be heightened for the game in Paris between the Steelers and Saints after civil unrest engulfed the French capital last weekend.

items.headline: NFL readies for Steelers-Saints in Paris amid civil unrest, security concerns
items.description: The NFL is ramping up for its first-ever regular-season game in France amid civil unrest and security concerns in Paris.
